title: EARLY_BACKAWAY_FAR_COVER_ON: let only the P60 far-cover search/walk inside the back-away retreat fire from 10 s instead of 40 s (tree, building, P64 LOS-break keep their gates)
champion: P64 BACKAWAY_LOS_BREAK_ON, bot code 8ada6a4 (merge 297f133), site 3.90 builders-4 BB-0E81A218
builds_on: synergy_research.md opp 3: 67 official pre-40 s plain back-away deaths; P60 Step A t<40 skip bucket 2691/2019

interacts_with.interaction: the same search/walk/latch, only its time gate moves from TREE_RETREAT_MIN_T (40 s) to 10 s; P60's drop gate, seer test, 3 s give-up and skip list unchanged
keeps its own 40 s gate; before 40 s a back-away with no far spot stays the champion's plain back-away. Before 40 s no P64 decision exists to preempt, so the change cannot steal P64 activations
keeps its 40 s gate, so before 40 s a 4-6 s far spot can be chosen even where a 1-3 s tree spot exists (tree search is not run before 40 s)
precedes far cover in the branch order and has no time gate; unchanged. The 15 official pre-40 s building-cover deaths are not targeted
interacts_with.source: brain.ts retreat branch order; synergy_research.md opp 3

interacts_with.interaction: the retreat branches already preempt laser rush; a far walk is longer than a back-away and may carry us farther from the laser we were rushing, so arm-up could be delayed
P60's drop gate applies unchanged: never in a drop run or ring hold, never while a drop is near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M (never 'any drop exists')

hypothesis: Before 40 s the back-away retreat never uses P60's far-cover walk because it inherits the tree retreat's 40 s gate. 67 official games end in a plain back-away death before 40 s (39 on 2000+3000, 28 on 4000+5000), and t<40 is the largest skip bucket of P60's Step A (2691 and 2019 back-away decisions). If a 4-6 s spot hidden from the shooters exists in a useful share of those decisions, walking to it instead of backing straight away breaks LOS sooner and turns some early back-away deaths into survivals.
mechanism: One flag EARLY_BACKAWAY_FAR_COVER_ON (default false) and one value EARLY_BACKAWAY_FAR_MIN_T = 10. When on, farRetreat's time gate is 10 s instead of TREE_RETREAT_MIN_T (40 s); nothing else changes: same branch position (after building cover and tree retreat, before P64 and plain back-away), same drop gate (no drop run/hold, no near-and-reachable drop within DROP_RUN_M), same shooters/seers test, same 4/5/6 s search, latch, 3 s no-progress give-up and skip list. Never at t < 10 s. Legs only; aim/torso/timing untouched (N8).
activation: Decision-level: mode 'retreat' (plain back-away) at 10 s <= t < 40 s, P60's gates pass with the drop gate, and the far search returns a spot whose heading differs from the back-away heading by > 20 deg (P60's Step A definition). Game-level Step A count = games where this happens at least once, per 192-game set.
disproof: Fails if Step A fire-and-change < 10/192 on either set (2000+3000, 4000+5000), OR deaths < 40 s rise on either practice base (0, 6000), OR the paired mean vs P64 is lower on both practice bases, OR a NEW >= 20 s pin appears, OR there are 0 activations between 10 s and 40 s that change the move.
positives: Step A fires often (65/192, 51/192) and the changed games are the early-death games (43/48 and 31/38). With the 60 m seer gate: base 6000 deaths < 40 s 16->14 (6045, 6053 saved), base 0 kills 306->316 and survivors 3->4, means +0.104 and +0.000, drops 3->5 and 1->2, no new pins, 0 activations before 10 s.
negatives: Ungated (round 1) the early far walk raised deaths < 40 s on both bases (24->29, 16->18) and lowered both means (-0.094, -0.021): 13 and 8 early deaths moved into far-cover mode. Most early back-away fights are lost either way (bucket d / multi-shooter); a 4-6 s walk that is mostly sideways (45-90 deg) at gun range (< 60 m) gives up the range the straight back-away gains. Even with the 60 m gate base 0 kept 2 new early deaths (49, 85) and the gate was tuned on the same practice bases.
confidence: Disproven as built (item 5 failed in both rounds on base 0); the >= 60 m sub-cell is Uncertain (9-19 games per base, gate chosen on those bases)
reuse: 1) Far cover is not free before 40 s: the champion's straight back-away beats a sideways walk when a seer is inside gun near range (60 m). Any early retreat-route change should be gated on seer range. 2) The Step A logger (plain back-away decisions, 40 s gate lifted, P60 gates, heading change > 20 deg) and the passive diag pattern (log angle / nearest seer per far decision) are reusable. 3) The ~60-100 m sub-cell (15 games, place +5, early-death net -2) is the only promising part; a fresh idea would need its own Step A on 2000-5000 with the 60 m gate.

novelty.vs_P32: P32 (FIGHT_FADE_ON) changed the engage finish walk (an offensive movement) and failed item 5 (deaths < 40 s 33->35). P68 changes only which spot an existing retreat walks to, in the decisions where the champion already retreats; the pre-40 s death count is the main risk and is a hard disproof here.
novelty.vs_P33: P33 extended retreat duration in mid phase behind an 'any drop on the map' gate and fired 0/96. P68 uses the near-AND-reachable drop gate (drop-gate-rule.txt) and acts in 10-40 s, before most drop windows.
novelty.vs_P64: P64 is the 'no far spot' leftover of the t >= 40 s cell; P68 is the t < 40 s cell, with P60's own search, and leaves P64's gate at 40 s.
novelty.vs_P60: Same mechanism; only the activation window changes (10-40 s added). Not a re-test under a new name: P60 never searched before 40 s.
